description: Methods with a reviewed candidate harness, upstream runner and comparison specification. Pipeline stage 5 reads this file from the reviewed WSIP base commit (never from the candidate's scratch tree). A method listed here has its stage-5 acceptance decided by the protected verifier; a method not listed is recorded as unverified (no reviewed harness). Adding an entry needs the same human review as the harness, runner and specification it names.

notes: single-branch binary CLAM on the synthetic CPU fixture (wsip.integration.verification)
the reference review record must be approved by a person before the verdict can be accepted
